Transforming, Enabling and Inspiring to bring about systemic reform one STEP (School Transformation and Empowerment Program) at a time. We build solutions that address specific challenges and gaps that influence the functioning of schools by providing an array of programs such as teacher support, school leadership development, community engagement through Parent-Teacher Meets, Resource Centre Revivals and setting up Learning Spaces at Home. Partnering with organizations at district, state, and national levels like State Education Departments, State Council for Education Research and Training (SCERT), District Institutes for Education and Training (DIETs), Block Education Offices, and Resource Centres, we enable co-creation of solutions aimed at improving school-level practices in a holistic manner. And we nurture the education ecosystem to amplify the focus on school improvement by enabling civil society organizations (through our incubation program - EduMentum) and sharing research and resources (through our research and design lab - CoLab). --> Milestones & Track Record • Within five years of operations, the program has got ready acceptance in over 200 schools across three educational blocks in Bangalore, including government-run and low-fee private schools. • Mantra was recognized by the Government of Karnataka for the Project of Active Cluster Engagement in 2018. • In 2019, Mantra signed an MoU with the Punjab State Education Board to transform 19,000 Government-run schools in the state. • In 2021 MoU signed with Bihar Education Dept, to strengthen capacities of district, block, cluster level education leaders. • In recognition of the success of the Micromovements Projects (MIPs) in Bihar, in August 2022 the National Body, Department of School Education and Literacy, launched the Vidya Amrit Mahotsav initiative to encourage MIP innovations across 1.5 million schools throughout the country. The initiative enables millions of education leaders to share their innovative pedagogies and inspire peers to engage in MIPs, small steps leading to better schools. http://scert.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/circular-vam-final-recovered.pdf • In 2021 recognised one of the organizations to participate in the N/Core Accelerator program. • Since 2018, Mantra has been working with the Delhi Commission for Protection of Child Rights to run an assessment-led improvement project in 5500 schools across the state. • Mantra4Change is supported through funding from esteemed organizations and individuals like Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited, Shibulal Family Philanthropic Initiative (Advaith Foundation), Wells Fargo, and Tech Mahindra Foundation, among others. • Mantra4Change is the proud recipient of WIPRO’s seeding fellowship grant – WATIS and have been a part of the first cohort of incubatees under NSRCEL Social, Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Bangalore. • The organization has developed associations with esteemed organizations, like the Azim Premji University, ISPF Foundation, BEETF (Bangalore Effective Education Task Force), IIMS (Indian Institute for Montessori Studies), etc. --> Donor Testimonial “Through the Micro Focus INSPIRE programme in India, we are building lasting relationships with our charity partners. Organisations like Mantra Social Services play a tremendous role in building sustainable and inclusive communities, and it is fantastic to partner with them in their journey." testimonial from Pushpanjali Sakia from Micro Focus --> --> Leadership Team Khushboo Awasthi Director & Co-Founder Saurabh Singh Director - Rucha Pande COO Revathi P. Mantra4Change received The Schwab Foundation, Collective Social Innovation Award in recognition of the work in creating the four-member organization collective in 2019, the Punjab Education Collective. This award is a new category, and M4C is the proud first recipient for its achievements in education improvements in Punjab.
